units.zh: 外國下
units.en: Foreign States, Continued
units.literal: Foreign Countries, Part Two

units.zh: 高麗國王，王楷。
units.en: The king of Goryeo was Wang Kai.
units.literal: The king of the state of Goryeo was Wang Kai.

units.zh: 其地鴨綠江以東，曷懶路以南，東南皆至於海。
units.en: Its territory extended east of the Yalu River and south of the Halin Route, with the southeast bounded entirely by the sea.
units.literal: Its land lay east of the Yalu River and south of the Halin Route; to the southeast it reached the sea on all sides.

units.zh: 自遼時，歲時遣使修貢，事具《遼史》。
units.en: Since the Liao period it had sent annual tribute missions; the details are given in the 《History of Liao》.
units.literal: From the time of the Liao, each year envoys were sent to present tribute; the matter is fully recorded in the 《History of Liao》.

units.zh: 唐初，靺鞨有粟末、黑水兩部，皆臣屬於高麗。
units.en: In the early Tang, the Mohe were divided into the Sumo and Heishui branches, both of which acknowledged Goryeo as their overlord.
units.literal: At the beginning of the Tang, among the Mohe there were the two divisions of Sumo and Heishui, both of which were subject to Goryeo.

units.zh: 唐滅高麗，粟末保東牟山漸強大，號渤海，姓大氏，有文物禮樂。
units.en: After the Tang conquered Goryeo, the Sumo Mohe who held Dongmoushan grew steadily stronger, proclaimed the state of Bohai under the Da clan, and developed a full court culture with rites and music.
units.literal: When the Tang destroyed Goryeo, the Sumo, holding Dongmoushan, gradually grew powerful, styled themselves Bohai, took the surname Da, and possessed culture, rites, and music.

units.zh: 至唐末稍衰，自後不復有聞。
units.en: By the late Tang it had begun to wane, and after that it vanished from the record.
units.literal: By the end of the Tang it had declined somewhat, and thereafter nothing more was heard of it.

units.zh: 金伐遼，渤海來歸，蓋其遺裔也。
units.en: When the Jin campaigned against the Liao, the Bohai submitted—they were likely descendants of that former state.
units.literal: When the Jin attacked the Liao, Bohai came to submit; they were probably its surviving descendants.

units.zh: 黑水靺鞨居古肅慎地，有山曰白山，蓋長白山，金國之所起焉。
units.en: The Heishui Mohe inhabited the old territory of the Sushen. They had a mountain called White Mountain—likely Changbai Mountain—where the Jin state had its origins.
units.literal: The Heishui Mohe dwelt in the ancient land of the Sushen; there was a mountain called Baishan, which was probably Changbaishan, where the state of Jin had its rise.

units.zh: 女直雖舊屬高麗，不復相通者久矣。
units.en: The Jurchen had once been under Goryeo's sway, but the two peoples had been out of contact for a long time.
units.literal: Although the Jurchen had formerly been subject to Goryeo, they had long ceased to have contact.

units.zh: 及金滅遼，高麗以事遼舊禮稱臣于金。
units.en: After the Jin overthrew the Liao, Goryeo acknowledged Jin suzerainty using the same ceremonial forms it had formerly observed toward the Liao.
units.literal: When the Jin destroyed the Liao, Goryeo, following the old ceremonies used toward the Liao, declared itself a vassal of the Jin.

units.zh: 初，有醫者善治疾，本高麗人，不知其始自何而來，亦不著其姓名，居女直之完顏部。
units.en: Early on there was a physician renowned for his skill. A native of Goryeo, he had come from parts unknown and left no name in the record; he settled among the Wanyan Jurchen.
units.literal: At first there was a physician skilled at treating illness; he was originally a man of Goryeo, but it was not known whence he had first come, nor was his name recorded. He lived among the Wanyan clan of the Jurchen.

units.zh: 穆宗時戚屬有疾，此醫者診視之，穆宗謂醫者曰：「汝能使此人病癒，則吾遣人送汝歸汝鄉國。」
units.en: In the reign of Emperor Muzong a royal kinsman fell ill, and this physician was called to treat him. Muzong told the physician, "If you can cure him, I will have you escorted home to your own country."
units.literal: During the reign of Emperor Muzong a kinsman fell ill; this physician examined and treated him. Muzong said to the physician, "If you can cure this person's illness, I shall send someone to escort you back to your native country."

units.zh: 醫者曰：「諾。」
units.en: The physician answered, "I shall."
units.literal: The physician said, "I agree."

units.zh: 其人疾果愈，穆宗乃以初約歸之。
units.en: The patient recovered, and Muzong honored his original promise and sent the physician home.
units.literal: That person's illness was indeed cured, and Muzong thereupon fulfilled the original promise and sent him home.

units.zh: 乙離骨嶺僕散部胡石來勃堇居高麗、女直之兩間，穆宗使族人叟阿招之，因使叟阿送醫者，歸之高麗境上。
units.en: Hushilai, a Pusan chieftain at Yiliguri Ridge, lived between Goryeo and Jurchen territory. Muzong dispatched his kinsman Sou'a to summon him and, at the same time, to escort the physician back to the Goryeo frontier.
units.literal: Hushilai, a tribal chief of the Pusan division at Yiliguri Ridge, dwelt between Goryeo and the Jurchen. Muzong sent his clansman Sou'a to summon him, and also had Sou'a escort the physician back to the Goryeo border.

units.zh: 醫者歸至高麗，因謂高麗人，女直居黑水部者部族日強，兵益精悍，年穀屢稔。
units.en: Back in Goryeo, the physician warned the court that the Jurchen of the Heishui branch were growing stronger by the day, their warriors ever more formidable, and their harvests consistently plentiful.
units.literal: When the physician returned to Goryeo, he told the people of Goryeo that among the Jurchen dwelling in the Heishui division the clans were growing stronger day by day, their troops ever more fierce, and their harvests repeatedly abundant.

units.zh: 高麗王聞之。
units.en: The king of Goryeo took heed of this report.
units.literal: The king of Goryeo heard this.

units.zh: 乃通使於女直。
units.en: He accordingly dispatched envoys to establish contact with the Jurchen.
units.literal: Thereupon he opened communications with the Jurchen by sending envoys.

units.zh: 既而，胡石來來歸，遂率乙離骨嶺東諸部皆內附。
units.en: Soon afterward Hushilai submitted in person, and all the tribes east of Yiliguri Ridge followed him into Jurchen allegiance.
units.literal: Shortly afterward Hushilai came to submit, and then led all the tribes east of Yiliguri Ridge to attach themselves inward.

units.zh: 穆宗十年癸未，阿疏自遼使其徒達紀來說曷懶甸人，曷懶甸人執之。
units.en: In the tenth year of Muzong, guisi year, Ashu, acting for the Liao, sent his man Daji to win over the Halin district people, but they seized him.
units.literal: In the tenth year of Muzong, guisi year, Ashu, on behalf of the Liao, sent his follower Daji to win over the people of the Halin district; the people of Halin seized him.

units.zh: 穆宗以達紀送高麗，謂高麗王曰：「前此為亂於汝鄙者，皆此輩也。」
units.en: Muzong handed Daji over to Goryeo, telling the king, "The men who have been raiding your frontier are exactly this sort of people."
units.literal: Muzong sent Daji to Goryeo and said to the king of Goryeo, "Those who have been causing disorder in your borderlands before this are all of this sort."

units.zh: 及破蕭海里，使斡魯罕往高麗報捷，高麗亦使使來賀。
units.en: After the defeat of Xiao Haili, he sent Woluhan to Goryeo with news of the victory, and Goryeo returned the courtesy with congratulatory envoys.
units.literal: After defeating Xiao Haili, he sent Woluhan to Goryeo to report the victory, and Goryeo also sent envoys to offer congratulations.

units.zh: 未幾，複使斜葛與斡魯罕往聘，高麗王曰：「斜葛，女直之族弟也，其禮有加矣。」
units.en: Not long after, he sent Xiege and Woluhan on another mission. The Goryeo king remarked, "Xiege is a junior kinsman of the Jurchen chiefs—let his reception be especially generous."
units.literal: Before long he again sent Xiege and Woluhan on a friendly mission. The king of Goryeo said, "Xiege is a clansman younger brother of the Jurchen; his reception should be enhanced."

units.zh: 乃以一大銀盤為謝。
units.en: He presented a large silver platter in gratitude.
units.literal: He thereupon presented a large silver platter as a gift of thanks.

units.zh: 厥後，曷懶甸諸部盡欲來附，高麗聞之不欲使來附，恐近於己而不利也，使人邀止之。
units.en: Afterward every Halin tribe sought to submit to the Jurchen. Goryeo, fearing that their proximity would work against its interests, sent men to block them.
units.literal: Thereafter all the tribes of the Halin district wished to come and attach themselves, but when Goryeo heard of this it did not wish them to submit, fearing that their proximity would be disadvantageous, and sent men to intercept and stop them.

units.zh: 斜葛在高麗及往來曷懶道中，具知其事，遂使石適歡往納曷懶甸人。
units.en: Xiege learned the full story while in Goryeo and on the Halin road, and sent Shi Shihuan to bring the Halin tribes in.
units.literal: Xiege, while in Goryeo and traveling the road to and from Halin, learned the full story of the affair, and thereupon had Shi Shihuan go to receive the people of the Halin district.

units.zh: 未行而穆宗沒，康宗嗣，遣石適歡以星顯統門之兵往至乙離骨嶺，益募兵趨活涅水，徇地曷懶甸，收叛亡七城。
units.en: Before Shi Shihuan could march, Muzong died and Kangzong took the throne. Kangzong sent him with troops from Xingxian and Tongmen to Yiliguri Ridge, raised additional forces, advanced to the Huonie River, swept the Halin district, and recovered seven rebel-held towns.
units.literal: Before he set out Muzong died and Kangzong succeeded. He dispatched Shi Shihuan with troops from Xingxian and Tongmen as far as Yiliguri Ridge, recruited more soldiers, pressed toward the Huonie River, marched through the Halin district, and recovered seven cities of defectors and fugitives.

units.zh: 高麗使人來告曰：「事有當議者。」
units.en: Goryeo sent envoys with a message: "There are matters that require discussion."
units.literal: Goryeo sent envoys to report, saying, "There are matters that ought to be discussed."

units.zh: 曷懶甸官屬使斜勒詳穩、冶剌保詳穩往，石適歡亦使杯魯往，高麗執冶剌保等，而遣杯魯曰：「無與爾事。」
units.en: Halin officials dispatched Xiele Xiangwen and Yelibao Xiangwen, while Shi Shihuan sent Peilu. Goryeo detained Yelibao and his party but sent Peilu back with the words, "This is none of your concern."
units.literal: The officials of the Halin district sent Xiele Xiangwen and Yelibao Xiangwen; Shi Shihuan also sent Peilu. Goryeo seized Yelibao and the others, but sent Peilu back, saying, "This has nothing to do with you."

units.zh: 於是，五水之民皆附於高麗，團練使陷者十四人。
units.en: In the end the Five Waters peoples all went over to Goryeo, and fourteen regimental commanders fell into captivity.
units.literal: Thereupon the people of the Five Waters all attached themselves to Goryeo, and fourteen regimental commanders were taken captive.

units.zh: 二年甲申，高麗來攻，石適歡大破之，殺獲甚眾，追入其境，焚略其戍守而還。
units.en: In the second year, jiashen year, Goryeo attacked. Shi Shihuan routed them with heavy casualties, pursued into their territory, burned their frontier posts, and withdrew.
units.literal: In the second year, jiashen year, Goryeo came to attack; Shi Shihuan inflicted a great defeat, killing and capturing in great numbers, pursued into their territory, burned and plundered their garrisons, and returned.

units.zh: 四月，高麗複來攻，石適歡以五百人禦于辟登水，複大破之，追入辟登水，逐其殘眾逾境。
units.en: In the fourth month Goryeo attacked again. With five hundred men Shi Shihuan met them at the Bideng River, won another crushing victory, pursued them into the river, and drove the survivors beyond the border.
units.literal: In the fourth month Goryeo attacked again; Shi Shihuan with five hundred men met them at the Bideng River, again inflicted a great defeat, pursued into the Bideng River, and drove their scattered remnants beyond the border.

units.zh: 於是，高麗王曰：「告邊釁者皆官屬祥丹、傍都里、昔畢罕輩也。」
units.en: The Goryeo king then said, "The border incidents were the work of officials—Xiangdan, Bangduli, Xibihan, and their associates."
units.literal: Thereupon the king of Goryeo said, "Those who reported the border provocations were all officials—Xiangdan, Bangduli, Xibihan, and the like."

units.zh: 十四團練、六路使人在高麗者，皆歸之，遣使來請和。
units.en: He returned the fourteen regimental commanders and the six-route commissioners held in Goryeo and sent envoys to sue for peace.
units.literal: The fourteen regimental commanders and the commissioners of the six routes who were in Goryeo were all returned, and envoys were sent to sue for peace.

units.zh: 遂使斜葛經正疆界，至乙離骨水、曷懶甸活禰水，留之兩月。
units.en: Xiege was then sent to demarcate the border as far as the Yiliguri and Halin Huonie rivers, and remained on the task for two months.
units.literal: He then sent Xiege to survey and rectify the border, as far as the Yiliguri River and the Huonie River of the Halin district, and kept him there for two months.

units.zh: 斜葛不能聽訟，每一事輒至枝蔓，民頗苦之。
units.en: Xiege proved incapable of adjudicating disputes—every case sprawled into endless complications, and the people found it burdensome.
units.literal: Xiege was unable to hear lawsuits; every case tended to branch out endlessly, and the people suffered considerably from this.

units.zh: 康宗召斜葛還，而遣石適歡往。
units.en: Kangzong recalled Xiege and replaced him with Shi Shihuan.
units.literal: Kangzong recalled Xiege and sent Shi Shihuan in his place.

units.zh: 石適歡立幕府于三潺水，其嘗陰與高麗往來為亂階者，即正其罪，餘無所問。
units.en: Shi Shihuan set up headquarters at the Sanchan River, punished only those who had secretly colluded with Goryeo to stir up trouble, and left everyone else unmolested.
units.literal: Shi Shihuan established his headquarters at the Sanchan River; those who had secretly communicated with Goryeo and become agents of disorder were immediately punished according to their crimes, while the rest were not questioned.

units.zh: 康宗以為能。
units.en: Kangzong judged him capable.
units.literal: Kangzong considered him capable.

units.zh: 四年丙戌，高麗使使黑歡方石來賀嗣位，康宗使杯魯報聘，且尋前約，取亡命之民，高麗許之。
units.en: In the fourth year, bingxu year, Goryeo sent Heihuan and Fangshi to congratulate Kangzong on his accession. Kangzong sent Peilu on a return mission to renew the earlier agreement for the return of fugitives, and Goryeo consented.
units.literal: In the fourth year, bingxu year, Goryeo sent envoys Heihuan and Fangshi to congratulate him on his succession; Kangzong sent Peilu on a return mission and to pursue the earlier agreement to recover fugitive subjects. Goryeo agreed.

units.zh: 曰：「使使至境上受之。」
units.en: Goryeo said, "Send envoys to the frontier to receive them."
units.literal: They said, "Let envoys come to the border to receive them."

units.zh: 康宗以為信然，使完顏部阿聒、烏林答部勝昆往境上受之。
units.en: Kangzong took them at their word and sent A'suo of the Wanyan clan and Shengkun of the Ulinada clan to the border to receive the fugitives.
units.literal: Kangzong believed this to be sincere and sent A'suo of the Wanyan division and Shengkun of the Ulinada division to the border to receive them.

units.zh: 康宗畋于馬紀嶺乙只村以待之。
units.en: Kangzong went hunting at Yizhi Village on Maji Ridge to await their return.
units.literal: Kangzong hunted at Yizhi Village on Maji Ridge to await them.

units.zh: 阿聒、勝昆至境上，高麗遣人殺之，而出兵曷懶甸，築九城。
units.en: When A'suo and Shengkun reached the frontier, Goryeo had them killed, sent troops into the Halin district, and built nine fortified towns.
units.literal: When A'suo and Shengkun reached the border, Goryeo sent men to kill them, and also dispatched troops to the Halin district, building nine fortified cities.

units.zh: 康宗歸，眾鹹曰：「不可舉兵也，恐遼人將以罪我。」
units.en: On Kangzong's return, his advisers all urged, "We must not go to war—the Liao will hold us accountable."
units.literal: When Kangzong returned, the multitude all said, "We must not raise troops, for fear the Liao people will hold it against us."

units.zh: 太祖獨曰：「若不舉兵，豈止失曷懶甸，諸部皆非吾有也。」
units.en: The future Taizu alone objected: "If we do not fight, we will lose not only Halin—every tribe will slip from our grasp."
units.literal: The Taizu alone said, "If we do not raise troops, we will lose not only the Halin district—all the tribes will no longer be ours."

units.zh: 康宗以為然，乃使斡塞將兵伐之，大破高麗兵。
units.en: Kangzong was persuaded and sent Wosai at the head of an army. He routed the Goryeo forces.
units.literal: Kangzong agreed and thereupon sent Wosai to lead troops against them, inflicting a great defeat on the Goryeo army.

units.zh: 六月，高麗率眾來戰，斡塞敗之，進圍其城。
units.en: In the sixth month Goryeo brought its main force to battle. Wosai defeated them and laid siege to their city.
units.literal: In the sixth month Goryeo led its masses to give battle; Wosai defeated them and advanced to besiege their city.

units.zh: 七月，高麗複請和，康宗曰：「事若酌中，則與之和。」
units.en: In the seventh month Goryeo sued for peace again. Kangzong said, "If the terms are fair, grant them peace."
units.literal: In the seventh month Goryeo again requested peace. Kangzong said, "If the matter can be weighed to the middle ground, then make peace with them."

units.zh: 高麗許歸亡入之民，罷九城之戍，複所侵故地，遂與之和。
units.en: Goryeo agreed to return the fugitives, dismantle the nine frontier garrisons, and restore seized territory, and peace was concluded.
units.literal: Goryeo promised to return the subjects who had fled inward, to abandon the garrisons of the nine cities, and to restore the formerly seized lands, and thereupon peace was made.

units.zh: 收國元年九月，太祖已克黃龍府，命加古撒喝攻保州。
units.en: In the ninth month of the first Shouguo year, after Taizu had taken Huanglong Prefecture, he ordered Jagusa to attack Bozhou.
units.literal: In the ninth month of the first year of Shouguo, the Taizu had already taken Huanglong Prefecture and ordered Jagusa to attack Bozhou.

units.zh: 保州近高麗，遼侵高麗置保州。
units.en: Bozhou lay near Goryeo; the Liao had carved it out during their invasion of Goryeo.
units.literal: Bozhou was near Goryeo; the Liao had invaded Goryeo and established Bozhou.

units.zh: 至是，命撒喝取之，久不下，撒喝請濟師，且言高麗王將遣使來。
units.en: Taizu now ordered Saha to capture it, but the siege dragged on. Saha asked for reinforcements and reported that the Goryeo king was about to send envoys.
units.literal: At this time he ordered Saha to take it, but it was long untaken. Saha requested reinforcements and also reported that the king of Goryeo would send envoys.

units.zh: 太祖使納合烏蠢以百騎益之，詔撒喝曰：「汝領偏師，屢破重敵，多所俘獲，及聞胡沙數戰有功，朕甚嘉之。
units.en: Taizu sent Nahe Wuchun with a hundred cavalry as reinforcements and instructed Saha: "You have led a detached force, repeatedly defeated strong enemies, and taken many captives. I have also heard that Husha has distinguished himself in battle. I am greatly pleased.
units.literal: The Taizu sent Nahe Wuchun with a hundred horsemen to reinforce him and issued an edict to Saha, saying, "You command a detached force and have repeatedly defeated powerful enemies, capturing many. I have also heard that Husha has been effective in several battles. I greatly commend this.

units.zh: 若保州未下，但守邊戍，吾已克黃龍府，聞遼主且至，俟破大敵複益汝兵。
units.en: If Bozhou still holds out, hold the frontier posts. I have taken Huanglong Prefecture and hear the Liao emperor is coming. Once we defeat him I will send you more troops.
units.literal: If Bozhou is not yet taken, simply hold the border garrisons. I have already taken Huanglong Prefecture and have heard that the Liao ruler is about to arrive; after we defeat the great enemy I will again augment your troops.

units.zh: 所言高麗遣使事，未知果否，至則護送以來。
units.en: As for Goryeo's promised envoys, that remains to be seen—when they arrive, escort them to me.
units.literal: As for what you report about Goryeo sending envoys, it is not yet known whether this is true; when they arrive, escort them here.

units.zh: 邊境之事，慎之毋忽。」
units.en: Be vigilant in all frontier matters—neglect nothing."
units.literal: Border affairs—be cautious and do not neglect them."

units.zh: 十一月，系遼女直麻懣太彎等十五人皆降，攻開州取之，盡降保州諸部女直。
units.en: In the eleventh month fifteen Liao Jurchen leaders including Maman Taiwan surrendered. Kaizhou was taken by assault, and every Jurchen band around Bozhou submitted.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, fifteen Liao Jurchen including Maman Taiwan were all bound and submitted; they attacked Kaizhou and took it, and all the Jurchen divisions of Bozhou submitted.

units.zh: 太祖以撒喝為保州路都統。
units.en: Taizu appointed Saha supreme commander of the Bozhou Circuit.
units.literal: The Taizu appointed Saha commander-in-chief of the Bozhou Circuit.

units.zh: 太祖已破走遼主軍，撒喝破合主、順化二城，複請濟師攻保州，使斡魯以甲士千人往。
units.en: After Taizu had routed the Liao emperor's army, Saha captured Hezhu and Shunhua and again asked for troops to take Bozhou. Taizu sent Wolu with a thousand armored men.
units.literal: The Taizu had already routed the Liao emperor's army. Saha took the two cities of Hezhu and Shunhua, again requested reinforcements to attack Bozhou, and the Taizu sent Wolu with a thousand armored soldiers.

units.zh: 二年閏月，高麗遣使來賀捷，且曰：「保州本吾舊地，願以見還。」
units.en: In the intercalary month of the second year, Goryeo sent envoys to congratulate Taizu on his victory and asked that Bozhou, "our former territory," be restored.
units.literal: In the intercalary month of the second year, Goryeo sent envoys to congratulate him on the victory and also said, "Bozhou was originally our old territory; we wish it to be returned to us."

units.zh: 太祖謂使者曰：「爾其自取之。」
units.en: Taizu told the envoys, "You may take it yourselves."
units.literal: The Taizu said to the envoys, "You may take it yourselves."

units.zh: 詔撒喝、烏蠢等曰：「若高麗來取保州，益以胡剌古、習顯等軍備之，或欲合兵，無得輒往，但謹守邊戍。」
units.en: He instructed Saha, Wuchun, and the rest: "If Goryeo comes for Bozhou, supply them with Hulagu's, Xixian's, and other forces as needed. If they ask to join operations, do not rush in—only hold the frontier posts firmly."
units.literal: He issued an edict to Saha, Wuchun, and the others, saying, "If Goryeo comes to take Bozhou, reinforce them with the armies of Hulagu, Xixian, and the like to prepare them. If they wish to combine forces, you are not to go rashly; simply guard the border posts carefully."

units.zh: 及撒喝、阿實賚等攻保州，遼守將遁去，而高麗兵已在城中。
units.en: When Saha and Ashizai attacked Bozhou, the Liao garrison fled—but Goryeo troops were already inside the walls.
units.literal: When Saha, Ashizai, and the others attacked Bozhou, the Liao defending general fled, but Goryeo troops were already inside the city.

units.zh: 既而，高麗國王使蒲馬請保州，詔諭高麗王曰：「保州近爾邊境，聽爾自取，今乃勤我師徒，破敵城下。
units.en: Soon the Goryeo king sent Puma to claim Bozhou. Taizu's reply read: "Bozhou lies on your frontier and I let you take it yourself. Instead you drew my army in to fight beneath its walls.
units.literal: Shortly afterward the king of Goryeo sent Puma to request Bozhou. An edict addressed the king of Goryeo, saying, "Bozhou lies near your border; I allowed you to take it yourselves. Yet now you have mobilized my troops and broken the enemy beneath the city walls.

units.zh: 且蒲馬止是口陳，俟有表請，即當別議。」
units.en: Moreover, Puma spoke only orally. When a formal written petition arrives, we may discuss the matter further."
units.literal: Moreover, Puma has only made an oral request; when there is a formal memorial petition, then another discussion may be held."

units.zh: 天輔二年十二月，詔諭高麗國王曰：「朕始興師伐遼，已嘗佈告，賴皇天助順，屢敗敵兵，北自上京，南至於海，其間京府州縣部族人民悉皆撫定。
units.en: In the twelfth month of Tianfu 2, Taizu notified the Goryeo king: "When I first marched against the Liao I made my intentions known. Heaven has favored the just cause, and I have repeatedly routed the enemy. From Shangjing in the north to the sea in the south, every capital, prefecture, district, tribe, and people in between has been brought under control.
units.literal: In the twelfth month of the second year of Tianfu, an edict addressed the king of Goryeo, saying, "When I first raised troops to attack the Liao, I already proclaimed it. Relying on Heaven's assistance in accord with the right, I have repeatedly defeated the enemy's armies. From Shangjing in the north to the sea in the south, among all the capitals, prefectures, districts, tribes, and people in between, all have been pacified and settled.

units.zh: 今遣孛堇朮孛報諭，仍賜馬一匹，至可領也。」
units.en: I now send Commander Zhushu with this notice and a gift of one horse—please accept them on his arrival."
units.literal: Now I send the commander Zhushu to report and notify you, and also bestow one horse, which you may receive upon arrival."

units.zh: 三年，高麗增築長城三尺，邊吏發兵止之，弗從，報曰：「修補舊城。」
units.en: In the third year Goryeo raised its Great Wall by three feet. Jin border officials sent troops to stop the work, but Goryeo refused and replied, "We are repairing the old wall."
units.literal: In the third year, Goryeo raised its Great Wall by three feet. Border officials sent troops to stop them, but they did not obey and reported, "We are repairing the old wall."

units.zh: 曷懶甸孛堇胡剌古、習顯以聞，詔曰：「毋得侵軼生事，但慎固營壘，廣布耳目而已。」
units.en: Halin commanders Hulagu and Xixian reported the incident. The court ordered: "Do not raid or provoke incidents—only strengthen your camps and extend your intelligence network."
units.literal: The commanders Hulagu and Xixian of the Halin district reported this. An edict said, "You must not invade or provoke trouble; only carefully secure your camps and widely deploy scouts."

units.zh: 四年，咸州路都統司以兵分屯於保州、畢里圍二城，請益兵，詔曰：「汝等分列屯戍，以固封守，甚善。
units.en: In the fourth year the Xianzhou Circuit command split forces between Bozhou and Bilwei and asked for reinforcements. The court replied, "Your separate garrison deployments to strengthen border defense are very good.
units.literal: In the fourth year, the supreme command of the Xianzhou Circuit stationed troops separately at the two cities of Bozhou and Bilwei, and requested additional troops. An edict said, "Your separate garrison deployments to strengthen border defense are very good.

units.zh: 高麗累世臣事於遼，或有交通，可常遣人偵伺。」
units.en: Goryeo served the Liao for generations and may still be in contact—keep scouts watching at all times."
units.literal: Goryeo for generations served the Liao as vassal; there may be communications between them. You may regularly send men to spy and observe."

units.zh: 使習顯以獲遼國州郡諭高麗，其國方誅亂者，使謂習顯曰：「此與先父國王之書。」
units.en: Envoy Xixian announced the Jin conquest of Liao prefectures to Goryeo, which was then purging rebels. A Goryeo official told Xixian, "This concerns my late father's reign."
units.literal: The envoy Xixian used the captured Liao prefectures and districts to notify Goryeo. That state was at the time executing those involved in disorder. The envoy said to Xixian, "This is a letter from my late father's reign."

units.zh: 習顯就館。
units.en: Xixian withdrew to the guest quarters.
units.literal: Xixian went to the guest lodge.

units.zh: 凡誅戮官僚七十余人，即依舊禮接見，而以表來賀，並貢方物。
units.en: More than seventy officials were executed in the purge. Goryeo then received Xixian under the old ceremonial forms, sent a congratulatory memorial, and presented tribute goods.
units.literal: In all, more than seventy officials were executed. Thereupon they received him according to the old ceremonies, and presented a memorial of congratulation together with local products as tribute.

units.zh: 複以遼帝亡入夏國報之。
units.en: They also reported that the Liao emperor had fled into Western Xia territory.
units.literal: They also reported that the Liao emperor had fled and entered the state of Xia.

units.zh: 高隨、斜野奉使高麗，至境上，接待之禮不遜，隨等不敢往，太宗曰：「高麗世臣於遼，當以事遼之禮事我，而我國有新喪，遼主未獲，勿遽強之。」
units.en: Gao Sui and Xieye were sent to Goryeo, but at the frontier the reception was insufficiently deferential and they dared not enter. Taizong said, "Goryeo long served the Liao and should observe the same rites toward us—but the court is in mourning and the Liao emperor is not yet captured. Do not press them yet."
units.literal: Gao Sui and Xieye were sent as envoys to Goryeo. At the border the reception ceremonies were not deferential; Sui and the others did not dare to proceed. Taizong said, "Goryeo for generations was vassal to the Liao and ought to serve me with the ceremonies used toward the Liao. But our state has a fresh bereavement, and the Liao ruler has not yet been captured—do not press them hastily."

units.zh: 命高隨等還。
units.en: He ordered Gao Sui and his party to turn back.
units.literal: He ordered Gao Sui and the others to return.

units.zh: 天會二年，同知南路都統鶻實答奏，高麗納叛亡、增邊備，必有異圖。
units.en: In Tianhui 2, Associate Southern Route Commander Heshida reported that Goryeo was sheltering defectors, strengthening frontier defenses, and likely harboring hostile intentions.
units.literal: In the second year of Tianhui, the associate commander of the Southern Route, Heshida, memorialized that Goryeo was harboring defectors and fugitives and strengthening border defenses; it must harbor ulterior designs.

units.zh: 詔曰：「凡有通問，毋違常式。
units.en: The court replied: "Maintain normal diplomatic exchanges in all communications.
units.literal: An edict said, "In all communications, do not depart from the usual forms.

units.zh: 或來侵略，則整爾行列與之從事。
units.en: If they invade, form your ranks and fight them.
units.literal: If they come to invade, then array your ranks and engage them.

units.zh: 敢先犯彼者，雖捷必罰。」
units.en: Whoever strikes first, even if victorious, will be punished."
units.literal: Whoever dares to strike them first, though victorious, will surely be punished."

units.zh: 詔闍母以甲士千人戍海島，以備之。
units.en: Yanmu was ordered to station a thousand armored men on the coastal islands as a precaution.
units.literal: An edict ordered Yanmu to garrison a thousand armored soldiers on the coastal islands as a precaution.

units.zh: 四年，國王王楷遣使奉表稱籓，優詔答之。
units.en: In the fourth year King Wang Kai sent a memorial declaring vassalage, and the court answered with a gracious edict.
units.literal: In the fourth year, King Wang Kai of the state sent envoys presenting a memorial declaring himself a vassal; a gracious edict replied.

units.zh: 上使高伯淑、烏至忠使高麗，凡遣使往來當盡循遼舊，仍取保州路及邊地人口在彼界者，須盡數發還。
units.en: The emperor sent Gao Boshu and Wuzhizhong to Goryeo with orders that all future exchanges follow Liao precedent and that every subject of the Bozhou Circuit and border region held in Goryeo be returned in full.
units.literal: The emperor sent Gao Boshu and Wuzhizhong as envoys to Goryeo. All envoys sent back and forth should fully follow the old Liao practices, and moreover the population of the Bozhou Circuit and the borderlands who were on their side of the boundary must all be sent back in full.

units.zh: 敕伯淑曰：「若一一聽從，即以保州地賜之。」
units.en: He instructed Boshu: "If they comply fully, grant them the Bozhou territory."
units.literal: He charged Boshu, saying, "If they obey in every particular, then grant them the territory of Bozhou."

units.zh: 高伯淑至高麗，王楷附表謝，一依事遼舊制。
units.en: In Goryeo, Wang Kai sent a memorial of thanks pledging to follow the old Liao ceremonial system in full.
units.literal: When Gao Boshu reached Goryeo, Wang Kai appended a memorial of thanks, following entirely the old system used in serving the Liao.

units.zh: 八年，楷上表，乞免索保州亡入邊戶。
units.en: In the eighth year Wang Kai petitioned to be excused from surrendering the Bozhou fugitives who had crossed the border.
units.literal: In the eighth year, Kai submitted a memorial requesting exemption from demanding the border households of Bozhou who had fled inward.

units.zh: 是歲，高麗十人捕魚，大風飄其船抵海岸，曷蘇館人獲之，詔還其國。
units.en: That year ten Goryeo fishermen were blown ashore by a storm. People of the Hasu Office detained them, but an edict ordered their repatriation.
units.literal: That year, ten men of Goryeo were fishing when a great wind drove their boat to the coast; people of the Hasu Office seized them, and an edict ordered them returned to their country.

units.zh: 既而勖上表請不索保州亡入高麗戶口，太宗從之，自是保州封域始定。
units.en: Soon afterward Xu petitioned again to waive recovery of the Bozhou fugitives in Goryeo. Taizong agreed, and from then on the Bozhou frontier was fixed.
units.literal: Shortly afterward Xu submitted a memorial requesting that the households of Bozhou who had fled inward to Goryeo not be demanded; Taizong consented, and from this time the territorial limits of Bozhou were first fixed.

units.zh: 皇統二年，詔加楷開府儀同三司、上柱國。
units.en: In Huangtong 2 an edict conferred on Wang Kai the ranks of Grand Master of the Palace with Golden Seal and Ribbon of the Third Rank and Supreme Pillar of State.
units.literal: In the second year of Huangtong, an edict added to Kai the titles of Grand Master with Golden Seal and Ribbon of the Third Rank and Supreme Pillar of State.

units.zh: 六年，楷薨，子晛嗣立。
units.en: In the sixth year Wang Kai died and was succeeded by his son Xian.
units.literal: In the sixth year, Kai died, and his son Xian succeeded to the throne.

units.zh: 大定四年，鴨綠江堡戍頗被侵越焚毀。
units.en: In Dading 4 the Yalu River frontier posts suffered repeated raids, incursions, and burning.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Dading, the fortified posts along the Yalu River suffered considerable invasion, crossing of boundaries, burning, and destruction.

units.zh: 五年正月，世宗因正旦使朝辭，諭之曰：「邊境小小不虞，爾主使然邪，疆吏為之邪？
units.en: In the first month of the fifth year, when the New Year's envoy took leave of Shizong, the emperor asked, "These minor frontier incidents—did your king order them, or were they the work of local officials?
units.literal: In the first month of the fifth year, Shizong, on the occasion of the New Year's envoy taking leave after audience, instructed him, saying, "Small mishaps on the border—did your lord cause them, or was it the frontier officials?

units.zh: 若果疆吏為之，爾主亦當懲戒之也。」
units.en: If frontier officials are to blame, your king should discipline them as well."
units.literal: If it was truly the frontier officials who did it, your lord should also punish and discipline them."

units.zh: 初，高麗使者別有私進禮物以為常，是歲萬春節，上以使者私進不應典禮，詔罷之。
units.en: Goryeo envoys had long brought private gifts in addition to official tribute. That year, at the Ten Thousand Springs festival, Shizong ruled these private offerings improper and abolished them by edict.
units.literal: Formerly Goryeo envoys had separate private presentation gifts that had become customary. That year, at the Ten Thousand Springs festival, the emperor considered the envoys' private presentations not in accord with proper ceremony and issued an edict abolishing them.

units.zh: 十年，王晛弟翼陽公皓廢晛自立。
units.en: In the tenth year Wang Xian's younger brother, Duke Hao of Yiyang, deposed him and seized the throne.
units.literal: In the tenth year, Wang Xian's younger brother, the Duke of Yiyang, Hao, deposed Xian and established himself.

units.zh: 十月，賜生日使、大宗正丞颭至界上，高麗邊吏稱前王已讓位，不肯受使者。
units.en: In the tenth month the birthday envoy Zhan, vice director of the Imperial Clan Court, reached the frontier. Goryeo border officials cited the former king's abdication and refused to admit him.
units.literal: In the tenth month, the birthday-congratulation envoy, the vice director of the Imperial Clan Court Zhan, reached the border. Goryeo border officials said the former king had already abdicated and refused to receive the envoy.

units.zh: 十一年三月，王皓以讓國來奏告，詔婆速路勿受，有司移文詳問。
units.en: In the third month of the eleventh year Wang Hao memorialized to announce his abdication. The court ordered the Basu Route not to receive him and instructed the relevant offices to send formal inquiries.
units.literal: In the third month of the eleventh year, Wang Hao came to memorialize and report his cession of the state. An edict ordered the Basu Route not to receive him; the relevant offices sent documents to inquire in detail.

units.zh: 高麗告曰：「前王久病，昏耄不治，以母弟皓權攝國事。」
units.en: Goryeo reported, "The former king had long been gravely ill and senile, unable to govern, and had entrusted state affairs to his uterine younger brother Hao as regent."
units.literal: Goryeo reported, saying, "The former king has long been ill, senile and unable to govern, and has had his younger brother by the same mother, Hao, exercise regency over state affairs."

units.zh: 上曰：「讓國大事也，何以不先陳請。」
units.en: The emperor said, "Abdication is a matter of the highest importance. Why was it not announced and requested in advance?"
units.literal: The emperor said, "The cession of a state is a great matter—why was it not reported and requested beforehand?"

units.zh: 詔有司再詳問。
units.en: He ordered the relevant offices to investigate further.
units.literal: An edict ordered the relevant offices to inquire again in detail.

units.zh: 高麗乃以王晛讓國表來，大略稱先臣楷遺訓傳位於弟，又言其子有罪不可立之意。
units.en: Goryeo then submitted Wang Xian's abdication memorial, claiming broadly that the late King Kai's testament directed the throne to his brother and that his son was guilty and unfit to rule.
units.literal: Goryeo thereupon sent Wang Xian's memorial of cession of the state, which in general terms stated that the late subject Kai's testamentary instruction was to pass the throne to his younger brother, and also expressed the idea that his son was guilty and unfit to be established.

units.zh: 上疑之，以問宰執，丞相良弼奏曰：「此不可信。
units.en: The emperor was skeptical and consulted his chief ministers. Chief Councilor Liangbi replied, "This cannot be credited.
units.literal: The emperor was suspicious and asked the chief ministers. The chief councilor Liangbi memorialized, saying, "This cannot be believed.

units.zh: 晛止一子，往年生孫，嘗有表自陳生孫之喜，一也。
units.en: First, Xian has only one son, and only last year a grandson was born—Xian himself once memorialized his joy at the birth.
units.literal: Xian has only one son; in a previous year a grandson was born, and there was once a memorial in which he himself reported the joy of a grandson's birth—that is the first point.

units.zh: 皓嘗作亂，晛囚之，二也。
units.en: Second, Hao once rebelled and Xian had him imprisoned.
units.literal: Hao once raised a rebellion and Xian imprisoned him—that is the second point.

units.zh: 今晛不遣使，皓乃遣使，三也。
units.en: Third, Xian sends no envoys while Hao does.
units.literal: Now Xian sends no envoy, but Hao sends envoys—that is the third point.

units.zh: 朝廷賜晛生日使，皓不轉達於晛，乃稱未敢奉受，四也。
units.en: Fourth, when the court sent a birthday envoy for Xian, Hao refused to forward him and claimed he dared not accept the mission.
units.literal: The court bestowed a birthday-congratulation envoy on Xian, but Hao did not forward him to Xian and instead said he dared not accept—that is the fourth point.

units.zh: 是皓篡兄誣請於天子，安可忍也。」
units.en: This is Hao usurping his elder brother and falsely petitioning the Son of Heaven—how can this be endured?"
units.literal: This is Hao usurping his elder brother and falsely petitioning the Son of Heaven—how can this be endured?"

units.zh: 右丞孟浩曰：「當詢彼國士民，果皆推服，即當遣使封冊。」
units.en: Right Vice Councilor Meng Hao argued, "We should inquire whether the Goryeo officials and people truly accept him. If they do, we may send envoys to invest him."
units.literal: The right vice councilor Meng Hao said, "We ought to inquire of that state's officials and people; if they truly all defer to him, then we should send envoys to invest him with the seal and patent."

units.zh: 上曰：「封一國之君詢於民眾，此與除拜猛安謀克何異。」
units.en: The emperor objected, "Consulting the populace before investing a foreign king—how is that different from appointing meng'an and mouke officers?"
units.literal: The emperor said, "To invest the ruler of a state after inquiring of the common people—how is this different from appointing and removing meng'an and mouke?"

units.zh: 乃卻其使者，而以詔書詳問王晛，吏部侍郎靖為宣問王晛使。
units.en: He sent the Goryeo envoys back and dispatched Jing, vice director of the Ministry of Personnel, with an edict to question Wang Xian directly.
units.literal: He thereupon sent back their envoys and, with an imperial edict, made detailed inquiry of Wang Xian. Jing, vice director of the Ministry of Personnel, served as envoy to announce the inquiry to Wang Xian.

units.zh: 皓實篡國，囚晛於海島。
units.en: Hao had in fact seized power and imprisoned Xian on a coastal island.
units.literal: Hao had in fact usurped the state and imprisoned Xian on a coastal island.

units.zh: 靖至高麗，皓稱王晛已避位出居他所，病加無損，不能就位拜命，往復險遠，非使者所宜往。
units.en: In Goryeo, Hao claimed that Xian had abdicated and retired elsewhere, that his illness was worsening, that he could not come forward to receive the imperial message, and that the route was too dangerous and remote for an envoy.
units.literal: When Jing reached Goryeo, Hao said that Wang Xian had already yielded the throne and was living elsewhere, that his illness was growing worse without improvement, that he could not come to his post to receive the command, and that the journey back and forth was perilous and distant—not suitable for an envoy to undertake.

units.zh: 靖竟不得見晛，乃以詔授皓，轉取晛表附奏，其言與前表大概相同。
units.en: Jing never saw Xian. He delivered the edict to Hao, obtained Xian's memorial indirectly, and forwarded it—the wording matched the earlier petition.
units.literal: Jing in the end could not see Xian. He thereupon presented the edict to Hao, obtained Xian's memorial in turn and appended it to his report; its wording was largely the same as the earlier memorial.

units.zh: 靖還，上問大臣，皆曰：「晛表如此，可遂封之。」
units.en: On Jing's return the emperor consulted his ministers, who all urged, "Given Xian's memorial, we should proceed with the investiture."
units.literal: When Jing returned, the emperor asked the great ministers, and all said, "Since Xian's memorial is thus, we may proceed to invest him."

units.zh: 丞相良弼、平章政事守道曰：「待皓祈請未晚也。」
units.en: Chief Councilor Liangbi and Privy Councilor Shoudao dissented: "Let us wait until Hao himself petitions—it is not too late."
units.literal: Chief Councilor Liangbi and the privy councilor Shoudao said, "It is not too late to wait until Hao petitions and requests it."

units.zh: 十二月，皓遣其禮部侍郎張翼明等請封。
units.en: In the twelfth month Hao sent Vice Minister of Rites Zhang Yiming and others to request formal investiture.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, Hao sent his vice director of the Ministry of Rites Zhang Yiming and others to request investiture.

units.zh: 十二年三月，遂賜封冊。
units.en: In the third month of the twelfth year the court granted the investiture patent.
units.literal: In the third month of the twelfth year, the seal and patent of investiture were bestowed.

units.zh: 皓生日在正月十九日，是歲十二月將盡，未及遣使，有司請至來歲舉行焉。
units.en: Hao's birthday fell on the nineteenth of the first month. With the year nearly over, the relevant offices asked to defer the birthday mission until the following year.
units.literal: Hao's birthday was on the nineteenth day of the first month; that year the twelfth month was nearly ended and envoys had not yet been dispatched. The relevant offices requested that it be carried out the following year.

units.zh: 十五年，高麗西京留守趙位寵叛皓，遣徐彥等九十六人上表曰：「前王本非避讓，大將軍鄭沖夫、郎將李義方實弑之。
units.en: In the fifteenth year Zhao Weichong, Goryeo's Western Capital military governor, rebelled against Hao. Xu Yan and ninety-five others submitted a memorial stating, "The former king had not abdicated but had been murdered by Grand General Zheng Chongfu and Colonel Li Yifang.
units.literal: In the fifteenth year, Zhao Weichong, military governor of Goryeo's Western Capital, rebelled against Hao and sent Xu Yan and ninety-five others with a memorial, saying, "The former king did not in fact abdicate; Grand General Zheng Chongfu and Colonel Li Yifang actually assassinated him.

units.zh: 臣位寵請以慈悲嶺以西至鴨綠江四十餘城內屬，請兵助援。」
units.en: Weichong offered to submit more than forty cities west of Cibei Ridge to the Yalu River and asked for military aid."
units.literal: Your subject Weichong requests that more than forty cities from west of Cibei Ridge to the Yalu River be brought within our allegiance, and requests troops to assist."

units.zh: 上曰：「王皓已加封冊，位寵輒敢稱兵為亂，且欲納土，朕懷撫萬邦，豈助叛臣為虐。」
units.en: The emperor replied, "King Hao has already been invested. Weichong dares to rebel and offer territory. I cherish all states under Heaven—how could I aid a rebel in his violence?"
units.literal: The emperor said, "King Hao has already received investiture. Weichong dares to raise troops in rebellion and moreover wishes to surrender territory. I cherish and pacify the myriad states—how could I aid a rebellious minister in his cruelty?"

units.zh: 詔執徐彥等送高麗。
units.en: He ordered Xu Yan and his party seized and handed over to Goryeo.
units.literal: An edict ordered that Xu Yan and the others be seized and sent to Goryeo.

units.zh: 頃之，王皓定趙位寵之亂，遣使奏謝，自位寵之亂，皓所遣生日回謝、橫賜回謝、賀正旦、進奉、萬春節等使，皆阻不通，至是，皓並奏之。
units.en: Soon Hao suppressed Zhao Weichong's revolt and sent envoys with thanks. He also reported that the rebellion had blocked the envoys he sent to return thanks for birthday gifts and extraordinary bestowals, congratulate the New Year, present tribute, and celebrate the Wanchun Festival; he now reported them all together.
units.literal: Shortly afterward, King Hao put down Zhao Weichong's rebellion and sent envoys to memorialize thanks. Since Weichong's rebellion, the missions Hao had sent for birthday congratulations and return thanks, transverse bestowals and return thanks, New Year's congratulations, tribute presentations, and the Ten Thousand Springs festival had all been blocked and unable to pass. At this time Hao reported all of this together.

units.zh: 詔答其意，其合遣人使令節次入朝。
units.en: The court acknowledged his report and instructed that the due missions proceed to court in proper order.
units.literal: An edict acknowledged his meaning and ordered that the envoys who ought to be sent should come to court in proper sequence.

units.zh: 十七年，賀正旦禮物，玉帶乃石似玉者，有司請移問，上曰：「彼小國無能識者，誤以為玉耳，不必移問。」
units.en: In the seventeenth year the New Year's gifts included a belt of stone that resembled jade. Officials proposed a formal inquiry, but the emperor said, "That small state lacks experts—they mistook stone for jade. No inquiry is needed."
units.literal: In the seventeenth year, among the New Year's congratulatory gifts, the jade belt was in fact stone resembling jade. The relevant offices requested a formal inquiry. The emperor said, "That small state has no one able to distinguish—it was mistakenly taken for jade. There is no need for a formal inquiry."

units.zh: 乃止。
units.en: The matter was dropped.
units.literal: The matter was thereupon dropped.

units.zh: 十二月，有司奏高麗下節押馬官順成例外將帶甲三過界，上以使人所坐罪重，但令發還本國而已。
units.en: In the twelfth month officials reported that during the lower festival Goryeo's horse-escort officer Shuncheng had brought three armored men across the border without authorization. Though the offense was serious, the emperor ordered only their repatriation.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, the relevant offices reported that during the lower festival, the horse-escort officer Shuncheng had brought three armored men across the border contrary to regulations. The emperor considered the envoy's offense grave but ordered only that they be sent back to their own country.

units.zh: 二十三年，皓母任氏薨，皓乞免賜生日及賀謝等事，詔從之。
units.en: In the twenty-third year Hao's mother Lady Ren died. Hao asked to be excused from birthday gifts and congratulatory exchanges, and the court agreed.
units.literal: In the twenty-third year, Hao's mother, Lady Ren, died. Hao requested exemption from birthday bestowals and congratulatory thanks and the like; an edict granted this.

units.zh: 章宗即位，詔使至界上頗稽滯，詔移問，高麗遜謝。
units.en: When Zhangzong ascended the throne, edict envoys were considerably delayed at the frontier. The court sent an inquiry, and Goryeo submitted a humble apology.
units.literal: When Zhangzong ascended the throne, envoys sent by edict were quite delayed at the border. An edict was sent to inquire, and Goryeo humbly apologized.

units.zh: 明昌三年，下節金挺回至平州撫寧縣，毆死當驛人何添兒，有司請「凡人使往還，乞量設兵衞」。
units.en: In Mingchang 3, during the lower festival Jin Ting was returning through Funing County in Pingzhou when he beat to death the station attendant He Tian'er. Officials proposed, "For all envoys traveling to and fro, we request that guards be stationed as needed."
units.literal: In the third year of Mingchang, during the lower festival Jin Ting was returning and reached Funing County in Pingzhou, where he beat to death the post-station attendant He Tian'er. The relevant offices requested, "For all envoys going and returning, we beg that military guards be set in appropriate measure."

units.zh: 參知政事張萬公曰：「可於宿頓之地巡護之。」
units.en: Vice Grand Councilor Zhang Wangong said, "They can be patrolled and guarded at their overnight stopping places."
units.literal: Vice Grand Councilor Zhang Wangong said, "They may be patrolled and protected at their overnight stopping places."

units.zh: 上可其奏。
units.en: The emperor approved the proposal.
units.literal: The emperor approved his memorial.

units.zh: 詔自今接送伴使副，失關防者當坐。
units.en: An edict declared that from then on escort-host deputies who failed in border security would be punished.
units.literal: An edict ordered that from now on for escort-host deputy envoys, those who failed in border security would be punished.

units.zh: 故事，賀正旦使十二月二十九日入見，明昌六年十二月己卯立春，詔於前二日丁丑入見云。
units.en: By precedent the New Year's envoy was received on the twenty-ninth of the twelfth month. In Mingchang 6 spring began on jimao in the twelfth month, so an edict moved the audience to dingchou, two days earlier.
units.literal: By precedent, the New Year's congratulation envoy entered for audience on the twenty-ninth day of the twelfth month. In the twelfth month of the sixth year of Mingchang, on jimao day spring began; an edict ordered audience on dingchou, two days earlier.

units.zh: 承安二年，皓表自陳衰病，以國讓其弟晫。
units.en: In Chengan 2, King Myeongjong of Goryeo memorialized that he was old and ill and yielded the throne to his younger brother, Sinjong.
units.literal: In the second year of Chengan, King Myeongjong of Goryeo submitted a memorial stating that he was old and ill and that he was yielding the kingdom to his younger brother, Sinjong.

units.zh: 晫權國事。
units.en: Sinjong took charge of state affairs.
units.literal: Sinjong provisionally took charge of state affairs.

units.zh: 是歲，皓廢，晫嗣立。
units.en: That year Myeongjong was deposed and Sinjong ascended the throne.
units.literal: That year Myeongjong was deposed and Sinjong succeeded to the throne.

units.zh: 泰和四年正月乙丑朔，高麗傔人以小佩刀割梨廡下巡廊，奉職見而糾之，詔館伴官自今前期移文禁止。
units.en: On New Year's Day, Taihe 4, a Goryeo attendant cut pears in the corridor with a small knife. A palace officer reported him, and the court ordered host officials to send advance notices forbidding such conduct.
units.literal: On the first day of the first month, yichou day, in the fourth year of Taihe, a Goryeo attendant used a small waist knife to cut pears beneath the corridor of the side hall. A palace attendant saw this and reported it. An edict ordered the host officials that from now on they should send advance documents forbidding such acts.

units.zh: 是歲，王晫薨，子韺嗣立。
units.en: That year King Sinjong died and was succeeded by his son Huijong.
units.literal: That year King Sinjong died, and his son Huijong succeeded to the throne.

units.zh: 泰和七年正月，是時用兵伐宋，夏亦有故，獨高麗遣正旦使，詔不賜曲宴。
units.en: In the first month of Taihe 7 the court was at war with the Song and had business with Xia. Only Goryeo sent a New Year's envoy, and the court declined to grant the customary curved banquet.
units.literal: In the first month of the seventh year of Taihe, at this time troops were being used to attack the Song, and Xia also had its reasons; Goryeo alone sent a New Year's envoy. An edict ordered that no curved banquet be granted.

units.zh: 及天壽節，夏、高麗使者皆在，有司奏：「大定初，宋未請和，夏、高麗使者賜曲宴，今請依大定故事。」
units.en: At the Heavenly Longevity festival envoys from both Xia and Goryeo were present. Officials cited the early Dading precedent and proposed, "At the beginning of Dading, when the Song had not yet sued for peace, envoys from Xia and Goryeo were granted curved banquets. We request that the Dading precedent be followed."
units.literal: At the Heavenly Longevity festival, envoys from Xia and Goryeo were both present. The relevant offices memorialized, "At the beginning of Dading, when the Song had not yet sued for peace, envoys from Xia and Goryeo were granted curved banquets. We request that the Dading precedent be followed."

units.zh: 詔從之。
units.en: The request was granted.
units.literal: An edict granted this.

units.zh: 至甯元年八月，王祦薨，嗣子未行起複。
units.en: In the eighth month of Zhining 1, King Gangjong of Goryeo died; his heir had not yet left mourning to resume official duties.
units.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Zhining, King Gangjong of Goryeo died; his heir had not yet left mourning to resume official duties.

units.zh: 九月，宣宗即位，邊吏奏：「高麗牒稱，嗣子未起複，不可以凶服迎吉詔，又不可以草土名銜署表。」
units.en: In the ninth month, when Xuanzong ascended the throne, border officials reported, "Goryeo's dispatch states that the heir has not yet resumed official duties during mourning. He cannot receive an auspicious edict in mourning garb or sign a memorial using a mourner's title."
units.literal: In the ninth month, Xuanzong ascended the throne. Border officials reported, "Goryeo's dispatch states that the heir has not yet resumed official duties during mourning, that he cannot receive an auspicious edict in mourning garb, and that he cannot sign a memorial using a mourner's title."

units.zh: 禮官議：「人臣不以私恩廢公義，宜權用吉服迎詔，署表用權國事名銜。
units.en: Ritual officials ruled, "A subject must not set aside public duty because of private affection. He should provisionally wear auspicious garb to receive the edict and sign memorials with the title of one exercising regency over state affairs.
units.literal: The ritual officials deliberated: "A subject must not set aside public duty because of private affection. He should provisionally use auspicious garb to receive the edict and sign the memorial with the title of one exercising regency over state affairs.

units.zh: 俟高麗告哀使至闕，然後遣使致祭、慰問及行封冊。」
units.en: After Goryeo's mourning envoy reaches the court, the Jin will send envoys for sacrifices, condolences, and investiture."
units.literal: Wait until Goryeo's mourning-announcement envoy reaches the court, and then dispatch envoys to offer sacrifices, express condolences, and carry out investiture."

units.zh: 制可。
units.en: The court approved the recommendation.
units.literal: The decision was approved.

units.zh: 明年，宣宗遷汴，遼東道路不通，興定三年，遼東行省奏高麗複有奉表朝貢之意，宰臣奏：「可令行省受其表章，其朝貢之禮俟他日徐議。」
units.en: The next year Xuanzong moved the capital to Bian and Liaodong routes were cut. In Xingding 3 the Liaodong Branch Secretariat reported renewed Goryeo interest in tribute. Ministers proposed, "The Branch Secretariat may be ordered to receive their documents; the ceremonies of tribute presentation may be discussed slowly on another day."
units.literal: The following year Xuanzong moved the capital to Bian, and the roads through Liaodong were impassable. In the third year of Xingding, the Liaodong Branch Secretariat reported that Goryeo again had the intention of presenting memorials and coming to offer tribute. The chief ministers memorialized, "The Branch Secretariat may be ordered to receive their documents; the ceremonies of tribute presentation may be discussed slowly on another day."

units.zh: 宣宗以為然，乃遣使撫諭高麗，終以道路不通，未遑迎迓，詔行省且羈縻勿絕其好，然自是不復通問矣。
units.en: Xuanzong agreed and sent envoys to Goryeo, but impassable roads prevented a full reception. He ordered the Branch Secretariat to maintain ties without severing relations—but from then on regular contact ceased.
units.literal: Xuanzong agreed and thereupon sent envoys to comfort and instruct Goryeo, but in the end, because the roads were impassable, he had no leisure to receive them. An edict ordered the Branch Secretariat for the time being to keep them attached and not sever friendly relations, yet from this time onward communications ceased.

units.zh: 贊曰：金人本出鞨靺之附於高麗者，始通好為鄰國，既而為君臣，貞祐以後道路不通，僅一再見而已。
units.en: The appraiser observes: The Jin people originated among Mohe groups once subject to Goryeo. They began as neighbors, then became liege and vassal. After Zhenyou communications broke off, with only one or two further contacts.
units.literal: The appraiser says: The people of Jin originally came from the Mohe who had attached themselves to Goryeo. At first they exchanged goodwill as neighboring states; afterward they became ruler and subject. After Zhenyou the roads were impassable, and they were seen only once or twice.

units.zh: 入聖朝猶子孫相傳自為治，故不復備論，論其與金事相涉者焉。
units.en: Under the present sage dynasty Goryeo still rules itself by hereditary succession, so no fuller account is given here—only matters touching Jin affairs.
units.literal: Upon entering the sage dynasty they still governed themselves with succession from father to son, and therefore this is not further discussed in full; only matters involving Jin are discussed here.

units.zh: 金國語解
units.en: Glossary of Jin State Language
units.literal: Explanation of the Language of the State of Jin

units.zh: 今文《尚書》辭多奇澀，蓋亦當世之方言也。
units.en: The present text of the 《Book of Documents》 is often obscure—likely the dialect of its own age.
units.literal: The language of the present text of the Book of Documents is often strange and obscure; it too was probably the dialect of its own age.

units.zh: 《金史》所載本國之語，得諸重譯，而可解者何可闕焉。
units.en: Jurchen terms preserved in the 《History of Jin》, though known only through repeated translation, should be recorded wherever they can be understood.
units.literal: The native language recorded in the 《History of Jin》, obtained through repeated translation, cannot be omitted where it can be understood.

units.zh: 若其臣僚之小字，或以賤，或以疾，猶有古人尚質之風，不可文也。
units.en: Officials' childhood names—some denoting low birth, some illness—preserve an ancient plainness that should not be dressed in literary elegance.
units.literal: As for the childhood names of their officials and ministers, some denoting low status, some denoting illness, they still preserve the ancient preference for plainness and cannot be ornamented with literary elegance.

units.zh: 國姓為某，漢姓為某，後魏孝文以來已有之矣。
units.en: Dual state and Han surnames have existed since Emperor Xiaowen of the Northern Wei.
units.literal: The state surname being such-and-such and the Han surname being such-and-such—this has existed since Emperor Xiaowen of the Later Wei.

units.zh: 存諸篇終，以備考索。
units.en: They are preserved at the end of this chapter for reference.
units.literal: They are preserved at the end of the chapters for reference and search.

units.zh: 都勃極烈，總治官名，猶漢云「冢宰」。

units.literal: Dubojilie: the title of the chief governing official, as the Han would say "Grand Minister."

units.literal: Anban Bojilie: an office both honored and exalted.

units.literal: Wuguchu: in the dialect called Zaixiu, as if to say "never again."

units.zh: 以物與人已然曰「阿里白」。

units.literal: Having already given something to someone is called "Alibai."

units.literal: Wulibu: a name for stored goods and livestock.

units.literal: Xishi: as people say "constant flow."

units.literal: Wudian: bright star.
